title: 17 February 2015: Ringo Starr live at Peace Center, Greenville, SC, USA
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Peace Center in Greenville, South Carolina, USA, on 17 February 2015.

It was the fourth show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North and South America, which lasted for 39 dates between February and October 2015.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar, acoustic guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, percussion
